scope: Node memory-backed Storage: serialize/validate new state and persist it; disk, React and browser rendering are not timed.
method: Six alternating writes of two valid same-week/same-revision company states. Each supplied state is newly cloned outside the timer. Cold writes use a new Storage instance seeded with exact previous bytes; warm writes use one instance primed by a successful write. Every timed call uses the production writeBrowserSnapshot path.
notes: The new GameState still receives serializeState validation on every call.
This bounded benchmark ran alongside selected tests, so timings are illustrative; parse-count assertions are deterministic.
No company state from this benchmark is installed in the application or exported as a playable campaign.
